title: Alder Unfolding
description: A plain four-bar melody acquires small flowing notes between its steps. Those figures rise into the upper register as the tune moves down to the left hand, then the original song returns over a new bass. The final chords release into a single high D.
difficulty: Advanced cantabile within flowing eighth-note figures
technical_note: The quarter-beat notes in bars 9–12 retain the melody of bars 1–4; the intervening eighths soften its outline. The LH takes the opening four-bar phrase at bar 17, two octaves below the original. The final high D is alone after both hands have rested.

performance.note: Shape the moving eighths towards the quarter-beat melody. The accompaniment yields when the melody enters below; the last isolated note can linger in the room.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
